prompt.project_info: Photorealistic high-fashion portrait on a sunny European pebble beach.
prompt.main_subject: One generic approved adult blonde woman with long flowing hair, sun-kissed natural skin and confident carefree pose, wearing a lime-green crochet summer dress over a white bikini, matching green headband, black sunglasses, large gold starfish earrings and gold chain belt.
prompt.composition_elements: Vertical fashion portrait with subject sharp and shallow depth of field, turquoise water, beachgoers, seaside buildings and dramatic green cliffs in the Mediterranean background.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Bright natural midday sunlight, crisp highlights and soft background separation, confident chic luxury summer-vacation mood.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic 4K fashion photography, sharp face and crochet texture, natural perspective, realistic beach details and shallow depth of field.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a vertical photorealistic high-fashion beach portrait of one generic approved adult blonde woman with long flowing hair and sun-kissed skin, wearing a lime-green crochet summer dress over a white bikini, green headband, black sunglasses, gold starfish earrings and gold chain belt, standing on a sunny European pebble beach with turquoise water, beachgoers, seaside buildings and dramatic green cliffs, bright midday light and shallow depth of field.
